_README: Set spellings the join cannot reach on its own, mapped to the product they mean.
Keyed '<year>|<normalised set name>' exactly as the sales table spells it.
These are NAMING FACTS, not judgement calls, which is why they live in the repo
rather than only in KV: they ship with the deploy, survive a KV wipe, are visible
in review, and are covered by a test. The sorting desk still writes its own
aliases to KV for one-off human decisions, and those WIN over anything here.
Before adding one, check the product id exists — set-aliases.test.js fails on an
alias pointing at a product that is not on disk, because such an alias silently
resolves nothing while looking like a fix.
